import unittest
import json
from app import app

class TestAttendanceApp(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        """Configure test client and clear state."""
        self.app = app.test_client()
        self.app.testing = True
        self.app.config['TESTING'] = True
        # Clear state before each test
        self.app.storage['students'] = {}
        self.app.storage['attendance_records'] = {}
    
    def test_get_students_empty(self):
        """Test getting all students when empty."""
        response = self.app.get('/api/students')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(response.data), {})
    
    def test_add_student(self):
        """Test adding a new student."""
        response = self.app.post('/api/students', 
                                  json={'name': 'John Doe', 'email': 'john@example.com'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        self.assertEqual(data['name'], 'John Doe')
        self.assertEqual(data['email'], 'john@example.com')
    
    def test_add_student_missing_name(self):
        """Test adding student without name should fail."""
        response = self.app.post('/api/students', 
                                  json={'email': 'test@example.com'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn('error', json.loads(response.data))
    
    def test_add_duplicate_student(self):
        """Test adding duplicate student should fail."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'John Doe'})
        response = self.app.post('/api/students', 
                                  json={'name': 'John Doe'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
    
    def test_get_student_not_found(self):
        """Test getting non-existent student."""
        response = self.app.get('/api/students/999')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
    
    def test_mark_attendance_valid(self):
        """Test marking valid attendance."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Jane Doe'})
        response = self.app.post('/api/attendance/1',
                                  json={'date': '2024-01-15', 'status': 'present'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        self.assertIn('message', data)
    
    def test_mark_attendance_invalid_student(self):
        """Test marking attendance for non-existent student."""
        response = self.app.post('/api/attendance/999',
                                  json={'date': '2024-01-15'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
    
    def test_mark_attendance_missing_date(self):
        """Test marking attendance without date should fail."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Test Student'})
        response = self.app.post('/api/attendance/1',
                                  json={})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
    
    def test_mark_attendance_invalid_date_format(self):
        """Test marking attendance with invalid date format."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Test Student'})
        response = self.app.post('/api/attendance/1',
                                  json={'date': '15-01-2024'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
    
    def test_mark_duplicate_attendance(self):
        """Test marking duplicate attendance should fail."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Test Student'})
        self.app.post('/api/attendance/1', json={'date': '2024-01-15'})
        response = self.app.post('/api/attendance/1',
                                  json={'date': '2024-01-15'})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
    
    def test_get_attendance(self):
        """Test getting attendance records."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Test Student'})
        self.app.post('/api/attendance/1', json={'date': '2024-01-15'})
        response = self.app.get('/api/attendance/1')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        self.assertIn('2024-01-15', data)
    
    def test_get_all_attendance(self):
        """Test getting all attendance records."""
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Student 1'})
        self.app.post('/api/students', json={'name': 'Student 2'})
        self.app.post('/api/attendance/1', json={'date': '2024-01-15'})
        self.app.post('/api/attendance/2', json={'date': '2024-01-16'})
        response = self.app.get('/api/attendance')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        self.assertIn('1', data)
        self.assertIn('2', data)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
